title: What a battery costs, then and now
narration: The battery is the main reason an electric car costs more to build than a comparable gas car. But its price has fallen fast. In 2015, industry surveys put plug-in hybrid packs in the United States at about 400 to 480 dollars for each kilowatt-hour of storage. In 2025, packs for fully electric cars came in at about 99 dollars per kilowatt-hour worldwide. In a recent model by America's Department of Energy, a compact electric car's battery costs the carmaker about 9,200 dollars, on a car that would sell for about 33,700 dollars.
